claims: Continue invasive mechanical ventilation support with lung-protective settings and monitor ventilator parameters, given current spontaneous breathing trial/CPAP mode and ABG showing adequate oxygenation.
Monitor hemodynamics invasively (arterial line, PA catheter, CVP) and continue vasopressor support with phenylephrine drip for persistent hypotension (MAP 59-68 mmHg).
Recheck arterial blood gas and lactate to assess resolution of lactic acidosis (lactate trending down from 4.3 to 2.4 mmol/L) and metabolic status.
Monitor and manage analgesia/sedation via fentanyl PCA, targeting RASS 0 to -1, with frequent pain and sedation assessments.
Continue insulin infusion and monitor blood glucose closely (fingerstick glucose 85-140 mg/dL) to maintain glycemic control.
Replete electrolytes as needed, including magnesium (1.8 mg/dL) and potassium, and monitor serum levels given ongoing IV replacement.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit (Hgb 8.4-11.4 g/dL, Hct 25-30%) and assess need for transfusion, with serial CBC checks.
Perform daily assessment of readiness for extubation, including spontaneous breathing trial and neurologic status (GCS, RASS).
Continue VTE prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin and monitor for bleeding, given coagulopathy (INR 1.3-1.5) and thrombocytopenia (platelets 115-139 K/uL).
Maintain ICU disposition with continued monitoring and supportive care, including stress ulcer prophylaxis and bowel regimen.
